name: Eswatini
famous_for: Kingdom of Eswatini royal traditions, Umhlanga Reed Dance festival, Mlilwane Wildlife Sanctuary, and glass-blowing crafts.
tourists: Over 1.2M visitors; famous for Umhlanga Reed Dance at Ludzidzini royal kraal, Ngwenya glass factory, and Mantenga cultural village.
must_know: Eswatini is one of the world's last remaining absolute monarchies, ruled by the Ngwenyama (King) alongside the Ndlovukati (Queen Mother).
fun_fact: Ngwenya Mine in northwestern Eswatini contains iron ore workings dating back 43,000 years, the oldest known mine on Earth.
